check: read the exact pass conditions for goal item 5 rather than assuming the profile passes when it reaches 24 hours
why: The profile's verdict is written by StressFixture when it stops. Knowing the conditions lets the closing round say what it expects and notice a surprise, instead of only reading passed=true or false after the fact.
theToleranceIsOneHundredAndTwentySeconds: DURATION_TOLERANCE_SECONDS is 120, so with requestedSeconds at 86400 the threshold is 86280 seconds, or 23.967 hours. The comment in the source explains why elapsed time is part of the verdict: judging only whether any chunk completed certified a duration it had never observed.

statusAtTwentyPointThreeHours.checkpoints: 1859 sample files, so condition three holds
statusAtTwentyPointThreeHours.failure: not yet written, which is expected while the profile runs

whatThisMeans: Three of the four conditions already hold and the fourth is a matter of waiting. If the profile reports passed=false, the cause will be a failure recorded at teardown or a shortfall in elapsed time, and the report will name which.
